candidates.desc: Two window cleaners in helmets and harnesses stand on a suspended platform near the top of a skyscraper, squeegeeing the glass while the camera looks down at the tiny city streets far below.

In an animated old-town street market, a young woman with a basket walks between stalls under striped awnings. She picks ripe tomatoes from a friendly farmer, smells a peach, tastes cheese a vendor cuts for her, and strolls on through the busy stalls.

In a hand-painted animated city square a young woman sits on a case and plays a red accordion beside a fountain. Workers, elderly people and families stop one by one until a large crowd rings the square to listen.

In a retro cartoon, a woman in a red coat enters a little grocery shop, fills her basket with jars and a loaf of bread, pays the friendly bald shopkeeper three coins at an old cash register, and leaves through the door under the striped awning.

A man in a red hoodie walks down a city street and halts at a red octagonal sign that reads STOP FOR PIZZA; he shrugs, obeys the sign, walks to a sidewalk pizza cart and happily takes a bite of a slice.

In a large public park with mown lawns, bare trees, benches and a gravel path, a man in a dark jacket walks along the narrow stone rim of a round ornamental pond. Orange and white koi swim just under the surface below him. He wobbles, throws one arm up to keep his balance and topples in with a huge splash. He sits up soaked in the waist-deep water while people walk past on the path behind, then hauls himself back over the stone rim.

At dusk a young couple stands on the pavement outside a brightly lit convenience store, its glass front and stocked shelves glowing behind them. The woman, in a pale yellow wrap dress with a white frangipani in her hair, sips from a whole green coconut through a red-and-white striped straw; a close-up shows her drinking with the store's shelves of packets and bottles filling the background. She looks up at the tall man in a white t-shirt beside her; he looks down at her and says no. She keeps holding the coconut between them and smiles up at him as scooters and other shoppers pass behind.

Shot at night on a phone. Two young men climb over a tall black iron fence with spear-shaped tips, next to a red warning sign, and drop down into dark bushes and tree roots on the other side. They walk up through the dark, and then the camera lifts to show where they have come out: a vast city spread below them, thousands of lit windows in tall towers packed along both sides of a dark harbour, with more towers climbing the hillsides and low cloud glowing above them. The two sit down side by side on the concrete edge and look out over the lit-up city.

A woman in cat-eye glasses stands at a bus shelter looking up with her mouth open in amazement. From a moving train window a large roadside billboard advertising a house slides past above the motorway. Then she is standing in Times Square at dusk, turning on the spot under towers of huge lit advertising screens and grinning up at them.

A man in a green bomber jacket walks along a street past an old red-brick block with washing hung out over its small balconies, and puts his hand on the worn brickwork. He steps back and looks up, and right beside the old block stands a tall new tower of blue-green glass and steel that runs up out of the frame. He walks round to its front, where a smooth curved glass revolving door turns in a flat stone facade, and stares up at the rows of glass panels. The clip ends with him at the foot of an old stone building with tall columns and a heavy wooden door.

A man in a cap with a shoulder bag travels through a city by bus. He waits by the roadside as a small van passes, then steps up into a white city bus through the front door. A red double-decker bus drives past tall glass office towers. He climbs the narrow staircase inside the double-decker up to the open top deck, and at the top he throws both arms wide and shouts with delight as the bus drives on between the skyscrapers.

Evening light over an Italian city. A young woman in a white dress stands on the flat roof terrace of an apartment block and hangs washing on lines strung across it. The camera shows the view around her: rows of tiled and flat rooftops with aerials and chimneys stretching to the horizon, with washing lines hanging between the buildings below.

A traditional Dutch cheese market on a cobbled town square. Two carriers in white uniforms and orange sashes trot past with a wooden barrow stacked high with yellow cheese wheels on their shoulders, watched by a crowd of onlookers. A young carrier picks a heavy wheel off a pile, lifts it up to the camera and grins, then stacks more wheels into tall towers before clapping his hands over the finished piles.

In a supermarket a worker in a green polo shirt and apron reaches into a cardboard box full of drink cans standing on the floor by a cold room door. He carries the cans to the aisle and lines them up on a shelf already packed with rows of colourful tins and cans. He straightens the front row so all the labels face out, then picks up the empty flattened box and walks off down the aisle between the full shelves.

A woman in a white sundress and a straw hat walks up a stone path towards an ancient hilltop temple with tall columns in golden evening light, then runs down a narrow whitewashed alley under bright pink bougainvillea, then joins friends dancing arm in arm at a seaside table above a blue bay.

A uniformed guard walks through a marble museum hall past bronze statues in glass cases and framed paintings, raises a hand to hold someone back, opens a tall wooden door, points out the way for a family holding a map, then stands in the middle of the skylit hall with his arms folded while visitors walk past.

A young man in glasses stands by a large stone fountain in a Roman square staring open-mouthed at an open guidebook, with a domed church and an obelisk behind him; he holds the book up beside the fountain, sits on the wide steps of a columned church and points up at it, then looks out from a stone balustrade over the rooftops of the city and holds the open book up against the view.

A shaky running camera chases a figure along a city pavement at night. Lit shop windows and neon signs run down one side, parked cars and traffic lights line the road on the other, and tall apartment blocks with lit windows stand at the end of the street under a deep blue sky.

A cyclist in a yellow jersey and a white-and-yellow helmet is stopped at a big city junction, mouth open in shock; above and beside her a traffic light shows green and amber. The camera pulls back and pedestrians, runners and a dog stream across the striped crossing in front of her while tall buildings rise on both sides.

A woman in a beige utility vest holds a small rainbow flag up high and walks up a sunny cobbled street in an old Italian hill town; stone houses with shutters and balconies line both sides, and a long line of people follows her up the street.

A woman in a camel trench coat wheels a grey suitcase across a marble hotel lobby and out through a revolving glass door. She steps onto the wide paved sidewalk of a Paris street, cars passing on the road right beside her, and looks around while other people walk past her on the same pavement. She then comes back in and stops at the reception counter with a document in her hand.

At night on a neon-lit Korean shopping street, a young man with bleached hair and headphones around his neck cups a hand behind his ear towards the camera, then pulls the headphones up over his ears. The camera swings down to the pavement, where a big silver boombox with two round speakers stands next to a lamppost, playing while shoppers pass behind it. The clip ends at a concert in front of a towering wall of stacked loudspeakers, with a performer on stage and the crowd's hands in the air.

A young woman in an embroidered white blouse and jeans tours several public memorials. She crouches beside a seated bronze figure of a bearded man on a stone plinth and points at the inscribed plaque, then stands up and takes a selfie with it while a pigeon flies past. She then stands in front of a tall stone column topped by a winged bronze figure, filming it with her phone, and finally walks across a wide plaza below a huge metal figure with outstretched arms, throwing her own arms up in the same pose.

A young woman with long beaded braids in a yellow sunflower dress laughs in a covered fabric market, holding up a green and gold wax-print cloth between stacks of folded fabric, then wrapping it around herself. Next she sits in a narrow painted canoe that glides past a village of wooden houses built on stilts over the water, waving up at children sitting in a doorway above her. At the end she stands in the middle of a ring of men playing hand drums on a sandy village street at sunset, dancing as they drum.

A young man in a yellow beanie and denim jacket sits on a long wooden slatted seat in a green park, trees and paths behind him. Several books are spread out along the seat next to him and a huge open volume lies across his knees. He picks up a small dark red book, then bends over the big open one, flipping through its pages faster and faster with his mouth open. At the end he lifts the enormous brown book right up over his head with both hands and stares up at it.

Two boys carry a big cardboard box together into an open garage, the up-and-over door raised and the lawn and fence bright outside. They set it down among other flat-pack boxes, open one and find a football, which the smaller boy lifts out and throws. A close shot shows one boy tightening the bolts of a pale wooden bunk-bed frame. Indoors the finished bunk bed stands made up; the two boys bump fists and then sit side by side on the bottom bunk, laughing at the camera.

A selfie-stick shot of a young woman with pink-tipped hair and a bearded man crossing a wide Japanese city intersection at dusk. Filling the buildings behind and above them are huge illuminated advertising boards - stacked panels of neon lettering, brand logos and lit-up product pictures running up the facades on every side. The two walk towards the camera across the striped crossing with a dense crowd of people behind them; she pulls a wide-eyed, delighted face at the lens.

On a city street corner in the early evening, a tall sandstone apartment building with rows of wrought-iron balconies fills the corner, its ground-floor shops lit warm yellow, and the same buildings continue down both streets. A light brown dog trots across the empty cobbled road. The view follows the dog as it reaches the pavement and walks along the wall of the building past a street lamp and a street sign. Bare trees and a few falling autumn leaves stand against a clear blue sky.

In a long underground car park with a low concrete ceiling, bright strip lights and rows of white pillars, a young woman with a long red ponytail, in a black cropped jacket and black skirt, stands in the driving lane holding her car key high above her head and looks around. She lowers her arm, turns and walks away down the lane between cars parked in marked bays. A car with its headlights on waits at the far end, and a tabby cat sits on the bonnet of a parked car on the right.

On a rainy evening on a wide, wet stone plaza by the water, a smiling young woman with a dark bob in a cream trouser suit holds out a white paper model of a building with curved, sail-shaped roofs. Behind her stands the real building it copies: a huge white opera house with the same shell-like roofs and a glowing glass front, with people with umbrellas on its steps. Fireworks burst in the sky, and she hugs the model to her chest and looks up at them, delighted.

A young woman with very long braids, a green and pink varsity jacket, loose brown cargo trousers and white trainers walks along the narrow top of a wall on a city rooftop at dusk, coming straight towards the camera. Her braids swing as she moves. Tall buildings with bright neon signs and a busy street with cars lie far below. She stops close to the camera, laughs happily and waves with one hand.

Inside a grand, busy shop at Christmas. A young man in a green blazer with a name badge and a red and green striped scarf rides an escalator down towards the camera, carrying a tall stack of gift boxes, a rolled rug, a teddy bear and a lamp, with a guitar case on his back, and looks around in surprise. Behind him several floors of balconies with golden railings are crowded with shoppers, a huge decorated Christmas tree rises in the middle, and a glass dome lets in daylight.

In the hallway of an old apartment building, a young woman in a yellow jacket and jeans pushes open the folding brass gate of an ornate old lift with black ironwork and squeezes out of the small wooden cabin, hugging a huge potted palm. Leaves and soil fall onto the tiled floor. Crushed behind her inside are a man in a suit holding his briefcase over his head, an older woman with a small dog, and a man in a cap. A spiral stone staircase rises around the lift.

In the evening rain, the glass front of a tall apartment building shows many lit flats stacked one above another. On each level people do different things: a family eats at a table, people do yoga, a man irons, others sit on sofas. A crane holds a black grand piano on a strap outside one of the upper levels, and a woman on the balcony beside it stretches out her arms, then lowers them and watches. The view slowly moves back to show more of the building.

A laughing young woman in a pale yellow raincoat and jeans walks along the wet pavement of a rainy shopping street with shop fronts and white awnings. She holds a black umbrella and points at a shop window. She leads a small brown pony that carries paper shopping bags on both sides, one with a long baguette sticking out. A shop assistant in an apron stands in a doorway, and behind them a cyclist rides by and people hurry through the rain, one holding a box over his head.

Inside a huge antiques warehouse with skylights, a young woman with a long braid, in a camel coat, white top and jeans, walks slowly down the middle aisle, looking up at a large crystal chandelier and then around her with a smile. On both sides stand stacks of old furniture: a wooden rocking horse high on a shelf, shutters, glass cases with stuffed birds, an old barber chair and rolled carpets. An old man reads a newspaper in an armchair and another man crouches by a crate.

At a street newsstand on a wet city pavement in early morning light, a young man with dark hair, in a navy zip-up jacket, fingerless gloves and jeans, flips through a thick fanned-out stack of glossy magazines, then turns and holds the stack out to a customer whose hand reaches in from the right to take one. The kiosk behind him is packed with rows of colourful magazines, comics and sweets, a brass bell hangs from the roof and bundles of newspapers lie on the ground. A city bus passes behind.

At night on a rooftop between tall apartment blocks, a young woman in a red slip dress, a black leather jacket, gold chains and chunky white trainers bangs a copper pot again and again with a big wooden spoon, shouting with her mouth wide open. Neighbours in bathrobes and pyjamas stand around her, some covering their ears, some laughing, one holding up pot lids. Pigeons fly up, string lights and a washing line hang overhead, and pans lie scattered on the ground.

On a wide gravel promenade in a park, lined on both sides by tall autumn plane trees and old lamp posts and leading to an ornate iron gate, a huge flock of sheep walks down the middle of the path towards the viewer, herded by a black-and-white collie and a man with a wooden staff. Joggers and walkers with coffee cups line the edges of the path, golden leaves drift down onto the sheep and the low sun shines through the trees.

A small wooden drawbridge over a city canal is raised and split in the middle. A young woman in a brown leather jacket stands on one half and a young man in a navy jacket stands on the other half. Holding the white railings, they lean out over the gap of dark water and stretch their hands towards each other, laughing, but their fingers do not meet. Chains hang from the white beams above, a houseboat with plants is moored below, a bird flies past, and brick houses and autumn trees line the canal under grey clouds.

A busy old-town square on a hot, sunny day. In front a young man in a white shirt and dark tie holds a box of noodles at a street food stall, where a cook tosses noodles in a steaming wok and flames flare up. Crowds of office workers in white shirts and dark suits queue and eat noodles around the stall. The view rises to show a stone clock tower whose clock shows exactly twelve o'clock, both hands pointing straight up, above the crowded square. The light is bright and the shadows are short.
